title: Highway Re-Background — JSON Master Prompt (v3, JSON-output edition)
usage: Step 1: Open a new chat in ChatGPT / Gemini.
Step 2: Attach the reference photo (highway shot taken from a moving car).
Step 3: Paste this ENTIRE JSON as your message.
Step 4: The AI shows 20 highway types and asks you to pick one.
Step 6: You receive a JSON PROMPT for that road type (generation-ready) AND the generated image from it, with the SAME angle and composition as your reference — only the background changed.
Note: If you want the JSON prompt only and no image, add the line: JSON only, do not generate an image.
directive: I am attaching a reference photo. Treat this entire JSON as your operating instructions. Read every field before you write anything. Then execute the workflow EXACTLY, phase by phase. Generating an image before Phase 2 is complete is a failure of this instruction.
phase_protocol: PHASE 1 Analyse (silent) -> PHASE 2 Ask (present 20 highway types, wait for my number) -> PHASE 3 On my selection: FIRST output a filled JSON prompt object for the selected road type (schema: selected_output_schema, example: example_selected_json_output), THEN generate ONE image from that JSON, keeping the exact angle, composition and motion blur of the reference.

reference_decode.shot_type: handheld phone photo taken from a moving car, bright daylight, clear sky
reference_decode.camera_position: low viewpoint about 1.2-1.5 m above the road surface, positioned on the carriageway, aimed diagonally forward-left across the road
reference_decode.horizon_line: tree line and guardrail band sit just above the middle of the frame, roughly 40-55% from the top
reference_decode.vanishing_point: slightly LEFT of centre on the horizon
reference_decode.road_coverage: asphalt fills the bottom ~45% of the frame and recedes diagonally from the bottom edge to the vanishing point
reference_decode.anchor_geometry: a solid white edge line runs from the lower-left toward the horizon; a silver W-beam metal guardrail runs parallel just above it; a dashed white lane line enters from the bottom-right corner
reference_decode.sky: roughly the top 40%; deep blue at the top-left (#529cd1) fading to pale cyan / near-white haze at the horizon (#a9cce7)
reference_decode.midground: summer-green tree line, distance-hazed and desaturated olive (#475127 to #66755a); narrow sun-bleached grass verge strip (#938d6f to #9e967b)
reference_decode.asphalt_tone: warm brown-grey, lighter #9a9080 near the horizon and darker #6e635d in the foreground
reference_decode.motion: strong forward-motion blur; radial / directional streaking on the asphalt strongest in the foreground; slight horizontal smear on the roadside vegetation; fast-driving feel
reference_decode.light: high daylight sun slightly behind-left of the camera (late-morning look); road fully lit; no long cast shadows across the road
reference_decode.grade: realistic phone-camera look, mild HDR, mild saturation, subtle grain; an honest snapshot, not a glossy advertisement, no heavy filter

locked_attributes.camera: low viewpoint ~1.2-1.5 m above the road, on the carriageway, aimed diagonally forward-left
locked_attributes.framing: sky top ~40%, background band around the middle, road bottom ~45%
locked_attributes.horizon: just above the middle of the frame
locked_attributes.anchor_geometry: solid white edge line lower-left, silver W-beam guardrail parallel above it, dashed white lane line entering from bottom-right
locked_attributes.motion: strong forward-motion blur on the asphalt, mild smear on vegetation
locked_attributes.light_direction: sun slightly behind-left of camera unless the selected scene requires its own lighting mood
locked_attributes.grade: photorealistic phone snapshot, mild HDR, subtle grain
locked_attributes.rule: these MUST remain identical in every generated image and in every JSON prompt you output; only the background / environment changes

phase_1_analyse.action: Silently study the attached reference and lock every attribute in locked_attributes and reference_decode. Do not output the analysis. Do not generate anything yet.

phase_2_ask.action: Present the 20 highway types from the highway_types array in this JSON, one per line, exactly numbered 1-20, each line formatted as: <number>. <name> - <scene>
phase_2_ask.question: Which one do you want? Reply with a number (1-20).
phase_2_ask.then: STOP and wait for my reply. Do NOT output any JSON prompt or image yet. Do not skip this step under any circumstance.

phase_3_on_selection.trigger: When I reply with a number or a name from the list (accept a close match).
phase_3_on_selection.step_1: Output ONE JSON code block: the generation prompt for the selected road type, built with selected_output_schema, fully filled - no placeholders left, all values concrete. Take the matching scene, light and palette values from the selected entry in highway_types and enrich them with 5-10 extra descriptive words each.
phase_3_on_selection.step_2: Immediately after the JSON block, generate ONE image by following that JSON prompt literally, keeping every locked attribute from Phase 1; replace ONLY the environment / background.
phase_3_on_selection.step_3: After the image, output one short line: Saved prompt id: <prompt_id> - nothing else.
phase_3_on_selection.composition_rule: Any new elements you add (trees, mountains, sea, city, weather) must occupy the same position and scale band as the reference's original background, so the result is indistinguishable from the original photo except for the scene itself.
phase_3_on_selection.physics_rule: Match the physics of the new scene: asphalt reflections and glare must suit the new light, distance haze must behave correctly, and the forward motion blur must continue over ALL new elements identically.

selected_output_schema.description: Exact structure of the JSON prompt you must output for the selected road type. Every field is required and must be filled.

fields.road_type: string - the selected highway type name
fields.shot: string - photorealistic phone photo taken from a fast-moving car on a highway, plus day/weather summary

camera.height: string - about 1.2-1.5 m above the road surface
camera.aim: string - diagonally forward-left across the road
camera.lens_feel: string - phone wide lens, slight wide-angle edge stretch

composition.horizon: string - just above the middle of the frame

bands.background: string - occupies the same band as the reference tree line (~40-55% from top)

composition.anchors: array of 3 strings - solid white edge line from lower-left toward the horizon; silver W-beam guardrail parallel above it; dashed white lane line entering from the bottom-right corner

motion.asphalt: string - radial directional streaks, strongest in the foreground

scene.background: string - the selected type's scene, enriched with 5-10 extra descriptive words
scene.lighting: string - the selected type's light value from highway_types
scene.palette: array of 3-4 hex + name strings, from the selected type's palette value

fields.physics: string - asphalt reflections/glare match the new light, distance haze behaves correctly, motion blur continues over all new elements
fields.style_grade: string - realistic phone-camera look, mild HDR, mild saturation, subtle grain, honest snapshot, no heavy filter
fields.negative: array of strings - copy from negative_prompt
fields.flat_prompt: string - ONE reusable paragraph version of this same prompt (natural language) that I can paste into Midjourney / SD / Flux

final_prompt_template: Photorealistic 9:16 portrait phone photo taken from a fast-moving car on a highway. Camera: low viewpoint about 1.3 m above the road, positioned on the carriageway, aimed diagonally forward-left across the road. Composition: horizon just above the middle of the frame; road surface fills the bottom ~45% and recedes diagonally to a vanishing point slightly left of centre; a solid white edge line runs from the lower-left toward the horizon; a silver W-beam metal guardrail runs parallel just above it; a dashed white lane line enters from the bottom-right corner. Motion: strong forward-motion blur, radial directional streaking on the warm grey asphalt strongest in the foreground, slight horizontal smear on roadside vegetation; fast-driving feel. Grade: honest phone-camera look, mild HDR, mild saturation, subtle grain. Scene / background: {{SCENE}}. Lighting: {{SCENE_LIGHT}}. Colour mood: {{SCENE_COLORS}}. Physics: asphalt reflections, glare and distance haze must match the new scene, and the motion blur must continue over all new elements. No vehicles, no people, no text, no watermark, no logos. Aspect ratio 9:16 (1080x1920).
output_rules: Phase 3 step 1: output the filled JSON prompt object in a code block (no placeholders left).
Phase 3 step 2: generate exactly ONE image from that JSON prompt.
Aspect ratio must be 9:16 (1080x1920). If not possible, request portrait and crop to 9:16.
Photorealistic only; no illustration, anime, painting, 3D render or CGI look.
No text, no watermark, no logo, no people, no visible other vehicles (unless I ask).
If I say 'JSON only', output the JSON prompt and skip the image.
After the image, print only one line: Saved prompt id: <prompt_id>.
negative_prompt: road filling less than 40% of frame
hard_rules: Never skip Phase 2. Never output a JSON prompt or generate anything before I reply with a number.

The JSON prompt must always keep every locked attribute: same camera angle, horizon height, vanishing point position, road proportion, anchor geometry and motion-blur direction. Only scene, lighting and palette change.
Never change camera angle, horizon height, vanishing point position, road proportion, or motion-blur direction in the generated image either.
If the chosen type conflicts with the reference light (e.g. night, rain, fog), keep camera, composition and motion EXACTLY the same and change only the lighting mood to suit the scene.
If I reply with a name instead of a number, treat it as the matching entry.
If I reply with something not on the list, ask me once to pick from 1-20.

troubleshooting.problem: AI generated an image before asking
troubleshooting.send: Stop. Do not generate yet. First show me the 20 numbered highway types and wait for my number.

troubleshooting.problem: AI gave a paragraph instead of JSON
troubleshooting.send: Output the selected road type prompt as a JSON code block only, using the selected_output_schema structure, fully filled with no placeholders, then generate the image from it.

The composition is wrong. Lock: horizon just above middle, vanishing point LEFT of centre, road = bottom ~45% of frame, camera low at 1.3 m aimed diagonally forward-left, forward motion blur on the asphalt. Redo with the exact same composition.
Keep the strong forward-motion blur - the foreground asphalt must be streaked and smeared. This is a moving-car snapshot, not a still studio shot.
Wrong aspect ratio. Output must be 9:16 portrait (1080x1920).

troubleshooting.problem: Background pasted on top like a collage
troubleshooting.send: Do not paste the background on top. Rebuild the whole photo as one seamless scene: same camera, same geometry, the new environment must sit in the same band and scale as the original background.
